surfaces.name: mulmoterminal launcher CLI (npx mulmoterminal; init, stop, google login)
Local server HTTP, WebSocket and Socket.IO API plus GUI MCP server
RemoteHost companion PWA (mulmoserver.web.app, closed hosted relay)

claims.answer: Browser app served by a local server (localhost:34567, also through an SSH tunnel), a `mulmoterminal` launcher CLI, a responsive phone web UI and a closed companion PWA (mulmoserver.web.app) via RemoteHost for watching, answering and starting sessions. No desktop app, native mobile app or editor extension.

desktop_os.answer: No desktop app (facts.json desktopApp false); the launcher and server run on macOS and Linux (CI per PR) and Windows (CI per PR and daily) with no native tmux persistence on Windows.

mobile_apps.answer: facts.json: "a native mobile app" is listed under notFor; the phone gets the browser UI or the companion PWA.

browser.answer: Primary client: a browser tab with a grid of xterm terminals served by the local server.

mobile_browser.answer: Responsive web UI plus the mulmoserver.web.app companion PWA for watch, reply (yes/no/continue) and start from a phone.

cli.answer: `npx mulmoterminal` launcher with init, stop, google login, --cwd, --port and --no-open; it starts the server rather than controlling sessions.

editor_extensions.answer: No editor extension; bounded search of README and package files names none.

task_actions.answer: Start (launch form, issue ▶), steer (type in terminal), approve (answer prompts in cell or phone yes/no), review (diff and commit/push/PR), resume (OR RESUME HERE list).

notifications.answer: Browser attention chime and tally; Web Push to phones on finish or blocked turns only while RemoteHost (Google sign-in, mulmoserver) is connected.

cross_device_continuity.answer: Sessions live on the server (tmux-backed), so another browser or the companion PWA reattaches to the same sessions.

claims.answer: Seven hosted agent CLIs through an AgentAdapter seam (Claude Code default, Codex, Antigravity, Grok, Muse, GitHub Copilot CLI, Cursor CLI), Claude Code on Anthropic-compatible provider models, and any other command as a plain shell launcher. Gemini CLI, opencode and amp are listed as not supported.

harnesses.answer: Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity (agy), Grok, Muse, GitHub Copilot CLI and Cursor CLI are first-class; gemini-cli, opencode and amp are listed as not supported.

model_providers.answer: Claude Code can run against OpenRouter, Moonshot, LiteLLM or local Anthropic-compatible backends with per-session model choice; `claude-ollama` runs a local Ollama model.

custom_adapters.answer: Any command can run as a "launcher chip"/shell without resume, cost or status; adding a first-class agent means writing an adapter in code (capability matrix tiers).

session_integration.answer: Agent CLIs run in PTYs; status uses injected Claude hooks, Codex rollout logs and per-agent files rather than a uniform API.

mixed_harness_operation.answer: Cells run different agents side by side in one grid and roster, and a cell can pull another cell's last turn into its input.

limitations: custom_adapters: Any command can run as a "launcher chip"/shell without resume, cost or status; adding a first-class agent means writing an adapter in code (capability matrix tiers).

claims.answer: Local server exposes an HTTP API, WebSocket terminals and a Socket.IO pub/sub feed (documented in the README) plus a GUI MCP server for agents; the launcher has no session-control commands. The API has no authentication because the server binds to loopback.

cli.answer: `mulmoterminal` starts, stops (`stop`), initializes and links Google; no session create/steer commands.

api.answer: README "Server API specification" documents routes such as GET /api/sessions, POST /api/hook, WS /ws, /ws/run and Socket.IO /ws/pubsub.

sdk.answer: No SDK package; the npm package ships the app, not a client library.

mcp_server.answer: An in-process GUI MCP server gives agents tools (documents, forms, charts, images); it exposes UI tools, not session control to other agents.

webhooks.answer: Agents post activity to POST /api/hook from injected Claude hooks; no user-configurable webhooks.

operations.answer: HTTP/WS can create, list, write to and terminate sessions per the spec; review/delivery use git endpoints; no stable high-level operation set is promised.

authentication.answer: No login: loopback bind plus an origin allowlist guard; remote use relies on an SSH tunnel.

stability.answer: No API stability statement read; the project ships major releases frequently (12.x).

evidence.title: GitHub repository metadata
evidence.finding: 270 stars, MIT, pushed 2026-11-16, homepage mulmoterminal.com; latest release 12.1.2 (2026-11-10).

evidence.title: MulmoTerminal README
evidence.locator: Install & run; Agents; Session persistence; Git worktrees & pull requests; Cost & token usage; Configuration; Server API specification
evidence.finding: Browser grid of parallel agent PTYs with state colours, cockpit roster, tmux persistence, git worktrees with commit/push/PR, cost badges, GitHub/GitLab views, seven agent CLIs, Web Push through RemoteHost, local MIT server on loopback.

evidence.title: MulmoTerminal facts
evidence.locator: agents, agentsNotSupported, os, interface, features, notFor
evidence.finding: Machine-readable first-party facts: seven agents (claude-code, codex, antigravity, grok, muse, github-copilot-cli, cursor-cli); gemini-cli, opencode, amp not supported; desktopApp false; no native mobile app; containerIsolation and cloudExecution false; Docker sandbox removed in 4.0.0; macOS/Linux CI per PR, Windows CI without native tmux persistence.

evidence.title: Agent capability matrix
evidence.finding: Per-agent capability inventory (status dots, notifications, resume, GUI MCP, cost) for the seven hosted agents; any other CLI runs only as a plain shell launcher chip without resume, cost or status.

evidence.title: Run the server on another machine
evidence.locator: Why a tunnel, On the server
evidence.finding: Server has no login and binds 127.0.0.1; a VPS/container run is reached through an SSH tunnel; described as a first cut run end to end once.

evidence.title: Several subscriptions side by side (beta)
evidence.locator: What you get; 1. Add the account to the config
evidence.finding: Beta: extra Claude Code or Codex logins (accounts with separate config homes) per cell with 5h/7d usage gauges.

evidence.title: Token rotation (beta)
evidence.locator: intro; When a subscription runs low
evidence.finding: Beta: several Claude subscriptions registered once; new sessions start on the one with most room and a session moves at 98% usage keeping the conversation.

evidence.title: Run Claude Code against another model
evidence.locator: The shape of it; 1. Get an OpenRouter key
evidence.finding: Claude Code can run on Anthropic-compatible backends (OpenRouter, Moonshot, LiteLLM, local); providers are config, keys come from the server environment.

evidence.title: GitHub cross-repo PRs and Issues
evidence.finding: Cross-repo PR and issue view through the user's gh login (GitLab through glab); one-click worktree plus agent per issue.

evidence.title: Mobile notifications (Web Push)
evidence.finding: Web Push on finished or blocked turns, sent only while RemoteHost is connected via Google sign-in; delivery by the separate mulmoserver service.

evidence.title: From your phone
evidence.finding: The companion PWA mulmoserver.web.app lets a signed-in phone watch, answer and start sessions on connected hosts through the RemoteHost link.

evidence.title: Windows gotchas
evidence.finding: Windows traps with fixes; a windows-pr workflow runs tests on every non-docs PR and windows-daily runs lint, typecheck, build and tests on Node 22 and 24.

evidence.title: Changelog
evidence.finding: Releases 12.1.2 (2026-11-10), 12.1.1, 12.1.0 and 12.0.1 in the previous week; Unreleased empty.

evidence.title: Campaign mode design note
evidence.finding: Design memo for an orchestrator feeding the grid; states it is a concept ("not yet started" folder) built on the existing cockpit roster, worktree claim and scheduler.

evidence.title: Worktree pull requests
evidence.finding: `gh pr create --base --head --fill`, `gh pr list --head`, `gh pr view` and `gh pr edit` operations; GitLab uses glab equivalents.

evidence.title: Worktree session limit
evidence.finding: Server-side enforcement that an agent session claims a worktree exclusively (one worktree, one agent session).

evidence.title: GUI MCP broker
evidence.finding: In-process MCP broker routes agent tool calls to POST /api/plugin/<toolName> and publishes tool results back to the session; tool groups gate which tools a session sees.

evidence.title: Allowed origin guard
evidence.finding: HTTP origin allowlist guarding the local API against foreign web origins.

evidence.title: Scheduled run dispatch
evidence.finding: User tasks in config/scheduler/tasks.json and the opt-in worklog task spawn a scheduled chat session and record the real turn outcome; state and logs persist under the workspace.

evidence.title: Cost estimation
evidence.finding: Estimated dollar cost per session/day/month from agent logs with a built-in public price table.

evidence.title: Campaign state machine
evidence.finding: Server-side campaign phase machine (accept, lease, submit, review, verify, approve, auto-merge) with no route, UI or README entry in this release.

evidence.title: Bounded source search
evidence.finding: No telemetry or analytics code; word matches were "entry" substrings. The only outbound product calls are an npm update check (opt-out env) and the RemoteHost/mulmoserver link.

evidence.title: Bounded source search
evidence.finding: No roles, SSO, membership or user accounts; the local server has no login.

evidence.title: Bounded source search
evidence.finding: No native issue tracker; issues and PRs are read from GitHub/GitLab through gh/glab; the board is an experimental GitHub-backed view.

evidence.title: Bounded source search
evidence.finding: No container or VM launcher; facts.json states the Docker sandbox was removed in 4.0.0; only git worktrees and tmux sessions isolate work.

evidence.title: Bounded source search
evidence.locator: rg -i "pr merge|gh pr merge|deploy|release" server/git server/routes
evidence.finding: PR creation, update and status reading only; no merge or deploy action reachable from the UI (campaign auto-merge is unreachable).

changes.summary: Initial full-profile source pass over pinned release 12.1.2 (commit 3bca6c4): README, docs/facts.json, agent capability matrix, user guides, changelog, future concept notes and server source (git/worktree-pr, scheduler, MCP broker, origin guard) with bounded searches, covering all 51 criteria. The mulmoserver relay behind phone push and the companion PWA is closed and kept unknown.

locations.result: 12.1.2 (2026-11-10) is the latest release; releases ship every few days; release pages carry notes only, no dated commitments.
Per-release notes; Unreleased section is empty; no future-dated items.

Two Japanese concept notes (autonomous delivery pipeline, grid campaign mode) explicitly described as not yet started; campaign server code has no route or UI entry in this release; not treated as announcements.
Active tracker; remote-server usage feedback is requested in issue 2669; no dated product announcements read.
Documentation site mirrors the repository guide; no pricing or roadmap page.

gaps: The mulmoserver companion PWA and Cloud Function are not public, so their behavior, terms and roadmap could not be checked.
